title: Stage 4, People: invitations, single sign-on, profiles, access and limits
description: Serves PRODUCT.md's road, stage 4: "Invitations, single sign-on, TV sign-in from a phone, profiles, per-viewer access, viewing hours and stream limits, devices and activity." TV sign-in is planned in stage 1 (JS-311). A placeholder for the stage, to be split into tasks of one capability each before anything in it is built.
acceptanceCriteria: A friend joins from an invitation that gives them exactly what the operator chose.
A viewer signs in with the household's own single sign-on; no identity provider's token reaches the app, and Octave Web gets its usual web sign-in from it (#296).
A shared TV holds the household's profiles, each with its own history, languages and limits, and a profile can ask for a PIN.
Each viewer sees only what the operator allows, everywhere.
The operator sets the hours a profile may watch and how many streams an account may play at once; a viewer outside them is told why, and a refusal for streams names the devices playing.
A viewer sees and signs out each of their devices.
A viewer can hide tracks in languages they don't use; a film is never left without sound, and one switch brings every track back.
notes: Coarse placeholder: never build as it stands. Split it when stage 4 is planned.
